reason: The original protocol requires a minimum number of independent events but did not operationally define independence. Review found that some frozen 10-minute reception windows overlap, so counting every passing catalog row could count one broadband episode more than once.

clarification.candidate_event: An event whose fixed raw and response-corrected 10-80 Hz criteria pass on both H10N1 and H10S2.
clarification.events_conflict_when: Their frozen event reception windows overlap on either H10N1 or H10S2. Touching endpoints without positive-duration overlap do not conflict.
clarification.independent_event_count: Maximum cardinality subset of candidate events with no pairwise reception-window conflict on either station.
clarification.algorithm: Exhaustive subset search is required because the frozen candidate set is at most eight events; choose maximum cardinality and break ties lexicographically by source_time_code list.
